The status-run loop is over. Both reminders hit their 20-run limit and the platform paused them, so neither will start another run. Dev A confirmed theirs is paused as well. My last comment will wake Dev A one more time, since they lead the squad, but nothing after that can bring me back.

- **Clean up comment noise:** the issue now has about 30 status-only comments from the loop. They don't need any action.
